teaser.en: A small wild cola tree found only in the forests of south-east Kenya and north-east Tanzania.
teaser.sw: Mkola mdogo wa porini unaopatikana tu katika misitu ya kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na kaskazini-mashariki mwa Tanzania.
teaser.dg: Muhi mdide wa kola ya weruni, unaophahikana tu kpwenye matsaka ga kusini-mashariki ya Kenya na ga kazikazini-mashariki ya Tanzania.

summary.en: *Chitsamvia* is a small wild cola tree of the coastal forests, first described from Marenje forest in Kwale. Digo named it as a smaller version of *mtsamvia*.
summary.sw: *Chitsamvia* ni mkola mdogo wa porini wa misitu ya pwani, ulioelezwa kwa mara ya kwanza kutoka msitu wa Marenje huko Kwale. Wadigo waliupa jina kama umbo dogo la *mtsamvia*.
summary.dg: *Chitsamvia* ni muhi mdide wa kola ya weruni wa matsaka ga pwani, ambao waandikpwa kpwa mara ya kpwandza kula tsaka ra Marenje, Kwale. Dzinare ra Chidigo rinauonyesa dza *mtsamvia* mdide.

about.en: *Cola minor* is a shrub or small tree, a wild relative of the cola nut tree. Like other wild colas it has simple leathery leaves, small star-shaped flowers without petals, and fruits made of several pod-like segments holding large seeds. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Cola minor* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, jamaa wa porini wa mkola (mti wa kola). Kama mikola mingine ya porini, una majani sahili magumu kama ngozi, maua madogo ya umbo la nyota yasiyo na petali, na matunda yaliyoundwa kwa sehemu kadhaa zilizo kama maganda zinazobeba mbegu kubwa. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Cola minor* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, ndugu wa weruni wa muhi wa kola. Dza kola zanjina za weruni, una makodza magumu dza chingo gasigoganywa, maruwa madide ga umbo ra nyota gasigokala na vibapa, na matunda ganayohendwa ni seemu nyinji dza makakaya, zenye tembe kulu. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It is found only from south-east Kenya to north-east Tanzania, in lowland coastal forest. The specimen that defined the species was collected in Marenje (Marenji) Forest in Kwale.
where.sw: Unapatikana tu kuanzia kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya hadi kaskazini-mashariki mwa Tanzania, katika misitu ya pwani ya nyanda za chini. Sampuli iliyotumika kuifafanua spishi hii ilikusanywa katika Msitu wa Marenje (Marenji) huko Kwale.
where.dg: Unaphahikana tu kula kusini-mashariki ya Kenya hadi kazikazini-mashariki ya Tanzania, kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ga tsi ya photsi. Chipande cha mmea chirichohumirwa kuionyesa aina ihi kpwa mara ya kpwandza chahalwa kula tsaka ra Marenje (Marenji), Kwale.

names.en: Pakia explains that *chitsamvia* is named after *mtsamvia*, the forest tree *Synsepalum*, but is relatively smaller, hence the prefix *chi-*. He lists it among the names that cannot be fully analysed. No Swahili or English name has been recorded. A related forest cola, *Cola uloloma*, is *mnapu*.
names.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba *chitsamvia* umepewa jina la *mtsamvia*, mti wa msituni *Synsepalum*, lakini ni mdogo kiasi, ndiyo maana una kiambishi *chi-*. Anauorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa kikamilifu. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Mkola mwingine wa msituni unaohusiana nao, *Cola uloloma*, ni *mnapu*.
names.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala *chitsamvia* chaihwa kpwa dzina ra *mtsamvia*, muhi wa tsakani (*Synsepalum*), ela ni chidide kuriko uo, kpwa hivyo dzinare rina *chi-*. Anariika kahi ya madzina ambago manage taganaweza kumanyikana gosi. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Kola yanjina ya tsakani, *Cola uloloma*, ni *mnapu*.

conservation.en: *Cola minor* is assessed as Near Threatened on the IUCN Red List. Its small range overlaps with the fragmented coastal forests of Kwale, which are under pressure from clearing.
conservation.sw: *Cola minor* imetathminiwa kuwa Karibu Kuwa Hatarini (Near Threatened) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN. Eneo lake dogo linaingiliana na misitu ya pwani ya Kwale iliyogawanyika vipande vipande, ambayo iko chini ya shinikizo la ukataji.
conservation.dg: Kpwenye *Red List* ya IUCN, *Cola minor* inaikpwa kahi ya mimea iriyo phephi na kukala hatarini (*Near Threatened*). Phatu unaphomera ni phadide, na phanaphahikana phamwenga na matsaka ga pwani ga Kwale garigo vipande-vipande, ambago ganatemwa sana.

reason.en: Synsepalum, the tree it is named after
reason.sw: Synsepalum, mti ambao umepewa jina lake
